findings.current: Large and small fragments that had once been part of a building more than fifty stories tall came pouring down, engulfed in flames.
findings.defect: “More than fifty” turns the source’s approximate quantity into a definite lower bound.
findings.rationale: The suffix 여 makes the building approximately fifty stories tall, not necessarily taller than fifty stories.
findings.replacement: Large and small fragments that had once been part of a building roughly fifty stories tall came pouring down, engulfed in flames.
findings.source: 한때 50여 층에 달하는 건물의 일부였던 크고 작은 파편들이 불길에 휩싸인 채 쏟아져 내렸다.

findings.current: By then, nearly a hundred monsters had raised their heads as though they had made a silent pact.
findings.defect: “Nearly a hundred” changes the stated quantity from approximately or fully one hundred to fewer than one hundred.
findings.rationale: 일백을 헤아리는 describes the monsters as numbering around one hundred without imposing the draft’s below-one-hundred limit.
findings.replacement: By then, the hundred or so monsters had raised their heads as though they had made a silent pact.
findings.source: 어느덧 일백을 헤아리는 괴물들이 약속이라도 한 것처럼 고개를 들었다.

findings.current: Limbs as thick as logs flew into the air, while dazzling aura cut through the Magic surging around them.
findings.defect: Capitalized “Magic” treats 마력 as the abstract practice or system of magic rather than the surging magical energy being cut.
findings.rationale: Here 마력 is an energy or power visibly surging around the combatants, not 마법 as a discipline or spell.
findings.replacement: Limbs as thick as logs flew into the air, while dazzling aura cut through the magical energy surging around them.
findings.source: 통나무처럼 두꺼운 팔다리가 허공으로 솟구치고 눈부신 오러가 넘실거리던 마력을 갈라 낸다.

findings.current:
The special Title **Hands-Off Spectator** will apply for the next 30 days.
>
> Due to the penalty effect of the special Title **Hands-Off Spectator**, all stats decrease by 10%.
findings.defect: “Hands-Off Spectator” is unnatural English and weakens the title’s accusation that Jin stood by idly while others suffered.
findings.rationale: 수수방관 means folding one’s arms and merely watching instead of intervening; “Idle Bystander” naturally preserves that condemnatory meaning.
findings.replacement:
The special Title **Idle Bystander** will apply for the next 30 days.
>
> Due to the penalty effect of the special Title **Idle Bystander**, all stats decrease by 10%.
findings.source:
― 특수 칭호, [수수방관(袖手傍觀)]이 향후 30일간 적용됩니다.

― 특수 칭호, [수수방관]의 패널티 효과로 인해 모든 능력치가 10% 하락합니다.

findings.defect: The draft completes the shocked, fragmentary utterance with an explicit question absent from the source.
findings.rationale: The source trails off after 어떻게, preserving Team Leader Choi’s inability to finish the thought.

findings.defect: The draft assigns the thought to the unidentified corpse, changing the subject of Jin’s self-question immediately before his own dazed, irrational action.
findings.rationale: The surrounding narration moves directly from Jin staring blankly to Jin suddenly grabbing an arm; the line questions his own state of mind rather than speculating about the corpse’s final thoughts.

summary: One critical subject error and several localized quantity, terminology, register, and wording issues.
